Class OpenApiRouteCallBinding

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.openapi.web.OpenApiRouteCallBinding
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.core.spring.call.CallLifecycleAdvisor.MethodBinding
public final class OpenApiRouteCallBinding extends Object implements com.sca4d.core.spring.call.CallLifecycleAdvisor.MethodBinding
通过路由目录匹配开放 Controller 方法，使方法无需 OpenAPI 注解也能进入 Call 生命周期。
